Headline: #15 Jeffery Local, #2 Hyde Park Express, and #172 U. of Chicago/Kenwood Temporary Reroute near Hyde Park/Kimbark
ShortDescription: 15 Jeffery Local, 2 Hyde Park Express, and 172 U. of Chicago/Kenwood buses are temporarily rerouted due to street blockage near Hyde Park/Kimbark.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#15 Jeffery Local, #2 Hyde Park Express, and #172 U. of Chicago/Kenwood buses are temporarily rerouted due to street blockage near Hyde Park/Kimbark.

Northbound #2 Hyde Park Express buses are temporarily rerouted via 51st, Woodlawn, 50th, Dorchester, 51st over to regular route.

Southbound #2 Hyde Park Express buses are not affected.

Eastbound #15 Jeffery Local buses are temporarily rerouted via 51st, Woodlawn, 50th, Dorchester, 51st over to regular route.

Westbound #15 Jeffery Local buses are temporarily rerouted via  51st, Blackstone, 50th, Woodlawn, 51st over to regular route.

Eastbound #172 U. of Chicago/Kenwood buses will operate via 51st, Woodlawn, 50th, Dorchester, 51st over to regular route.

Westbound #172 U. of Chicago/Kenwood buses will operate via 51st, Blackstone, 50th, Woodlawn, 51st over to regular route.

Allow extra travel time.
